syntax.blocks: Ordinary Cangjie trailing lambdas Column/Row/StatusBar/ScrollView and attribute chains return Component. A plain if/for runs once at construction.
syntax.state: Observable<T>.get/set/notify; getter lambdas retain reactive computation. Optional @Component/@State/@Bind macros are in cjtui.macros. @State requires typed initialized mutable instance field; macro restrictions remain diagnosed.
syntax.conditional_list: If getter and ForEach items/key/body are runtime declarations returning Unit. ListItem<T>.value is observable; stable nonempty sibling keys preserve identity. No generic ArkUI ForEach index semantics promised.
syntax.custom: Subclass Component, override build(): Unit, initialize fields then call protected finishConstruction() once; or @Component macro performs the equivalent. This is supported protected API, not a private RuntimeNode access.
syntax.events: Cangjie callbacks; mounted NodeRef operations, UI post and lifecycle cleanup. Unknown method/property is compiler/type error; supported method with invalid target/value has runtime diagnostics.
syntax.editor: No SDK/LSP/editor feature validation is added by this mapping.

functional_contracts.scope: text/rich text and safe ANSI input
functional_contracts.boundary: String control rejection; rich spans share Unicode/layout/style path; explicit bounded parser reports diagnostics, never device passthrough.
Cells/rows, actual terminal bounds, default vertical root viewport; shadow expands paint, not default hit/layout; optional NodeRef content coordinates are advanced controlled operations.

Explicit attribute > ordered reusable styles > role theme > inherited value > framework default; Reset stops fallback. Explicit validated loads, no default watcher; failed theme leaves accepted theme/state intact.
Observable model and instance-local controller; event capture/bubble/app/default within modal domain. Host-reserved keys need host forwarding configuration.

Clipboard/title/actual image icon are optional explicit requests with structured status/capability/error. Unknown is not supported; lack cannot prevent basic UI. No blanket host certification in AC004 mapping.

functional_contracts.scope: Frame/snapshot, diagnostics, custom drawing and device lifecycle
functional_contracts.boundary: Headless snapshot/manual Frame and Canvas local coordinates are advanced/test/export paths. Ordinary app.run owns input, layout, composition, diff and flush; output baseline commits only after full success. M1 reference and M2 optimizations share public API.

public_runtime.type: UIException <: Exception, public let code: String
public_runtime.note: Representative actual codes used by mapped construction/runtime operations; not a new exhaustive enum or promise that all errors are UIException.

other_failures: IllegalArgumentException for negative/invalid dimensions and incompatible overlay mode/options; ThemeException with ThemeDiagnostic for synchronous parse/read; asynchronous ThemeRequest terminal ThemeResult; AnsiTextException/decoder diagnostics for safe ANSI text; KeyboardException/diagnostics and structured SessionResult as documented.

Business getter/body/event exceptions preserve their identity; additional cleanup failures wrap primary and ordered extras in UICleanupException. Internal SessionDeviceException is not a public type applications must import.

Output failure invalidates device baseline; safe parser/mode resync precedes full repaint or output stops. Cleanup attempts restoration; physical restoration is not guaranteed when device operations fail.

ownership: Business data belongs to the application; component descriptor, mounted runtime identity and controller local state are distinct.
Same component type may have fresh instances in normal/modal hosts sharing Observable business state. One Component instance cannot mount twice.
onMount: (NodeRef)->(() -> Unit), cleanup clears public handles; references carry session/node identity and cannot revive after unmount.
Observable reads while evaluating getter record dependencies; replacing getter/unmount drops old subscriptions. Plain variable mutation alone has no reactive guarantee.

post returns enqueue acceptance, not execution or business success; owner post is discarded when owner invalid, queue full/inactive returns false; background work does not directly mutate nodes/Frame.

Batch merges invalidation and does not roll back business values after callback failure. onMount/lifecycle may post a later UI action; direct structural/focus/dispose reentry is rejected as specified.
Owner/subscription/post revocation precedes unmount cleanup. Closing parent layer closes owned descendants, maintains modal input isolation and restores valid focus; covered business state continues.
run owns terminal opening/input/render/cleanup; stop requests boundary shutdown. Headless start/snapshot/dispose is explicitly separate and does not establish terminal-host proof.
